titles.romaji: Shin Tennis no Ouji-sama: Hyoutei vs Rikkai - Game of Future
titles.english: The Prince of Tennis II Hyotei vs. Rikkai Game of Future
titles.native: 新テニスの王子様 氷帝vs立海 Game of Future

description: The new anime will tell an original story, featuring a match between the Hyoutei Academy Secondary Department led by Keigo Atobe and Rikkai University-Affiliated Middle School led by Seiichi Yukimura. The story was previously not depicted in the manga, it takes place after the U-17 World Cup.
